summary: The existing economic-time-series-correlation skill covers the core workflow well, but the trace revealed a year marker format variant ('2025 Q1' with space-Q) not handled by the existing parse_year_markers.py script. The script currently handles colon format ('2025:I') and dash-Q format ('2025-Q1'), but not space-Q. This patch extends the parser to handle this variant, updates the reference documentation, and adds a test case.
